maddeler.e:
استدركا (form X)
# اِسْتَدْرَكَا (istadrakā) /is.tad.ra.kaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# اُسْتُدْرِكَا (ustudrikā) /us.tud.ri.kaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# اِسْتَدْرِكَا (istadrikā) /is.tad.ri.kaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
